about.title: About M&M Roofing, Siding & Windows
text: For the past four decades, M&M Roofing, Siding & Windows has been providing the highest-quality roofing services to the Houston area. Our commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction has made us one of the most trusted and reliable roofing companies in Houston.

With more than 100,000 home improvement projects under our belts and 1000+ Google reviews, we have a proven track record of delivering superior roofs to our Houston customers. We know that putting on a new roof is a big decision and investment, which is why we provide a lifetime warranty on all new roofs.

Not sure if your roof needs to be replaced or just repaired? Our team of expert roofers will help you make an informed decision. We offer totally FREE roof inspections in Houston to assess the condition of your roof and provide recommendations.
